subject: Life Skills
title: Dealing With Roommate Conflicts
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Dealing With Roommate Conflicts.

hook.text: The number one cause of roommate fallouts is not mess. It's unspoken expectations about shared spaces.

buildup.text: Everyone has different standards for noise, cleaning, and guest visits. Assuming alignment causes friction.

discovery.text: A written roommate agreement covering chores, bills, quiet hours, and guests prevents most conflicts.

twist.text: Bringing up issues right away feels awkward but works. Waiting builds resentment that explodes later.

climax.text: Frame issues as shared problems, not blame. 'The dishes pile up quickly' works better than 'you never clean.'

punchline.text: Awkward conversations now prevent ugly ones later.
